ground.purpose: The page and the mobile top bar (deep navy in dark mode).

panel.purpose: Every panel and tile, composers, search at rest, the past on the day line, plain time pills (navy in dark mode).

panel-2.purpose: Tile hover, segmented track, ghost/icon hover, zero-spend bars, skeletons, keyboard keys.

card.purpose: Near-white row cards, insets, inputs, calendar cells, note previews, quick-note popover.

card-line-2.purpose: Card hover border, input and secondary button borders, empty check ring, dashed empty states, scrollbar thumb.

ink.purpose: All primary text; the Quick note button ground (cream text in dark mode).

ink-3.purpose: Placeholders, axis labels, kind icons, today-bar outline.

accent.purpose: The only accent: primary buttons, checked ticks, the now line, today's calendar date, selection, ordinary spend bars, focus, the auth brand mark.

accent-soft.purpose: Day-line event pills, next-up time pill, focus ring, text selection, search highlight.

accent-line.purpose: Inset edge of day-line event pills and the legend swatch.

red.purpose: Overdue and at-or-over-threshold data; errors and destructive actions in chrome. Token keeps the name red.

red-soft.purpose: Ground for overdue pills and chips, error callout, invalid ring, danger hover.

toast.purpose: Inverted toast ground (cream in dark mode).

toast-action.purpose: Undo action on the toast (wine on the cream dark-mode toast).

side-bg.purpose: Solid sidebar and mobile navigation sheet ground.

side-ink.purpose: Active nav label, hovered labels, the sidebar count and avatar initial, user name, sidebar focus outline.

side-ink-2.purpose: Nav labels at rest, the scope line, user email, sidebar icon buttons.

side-hover.purpose: Nav and sidebar button hover; also the toast action hover.

side-active.purpose: Current-page pill, the task count chip and the avatar disc in the sidebar.

side-mark.purpose: The brand mark in the sidebar: cream in light mode, rose wine in dark.

auth-title.purpose: Login and sign-up titles; auth preview greeting at 38px.

figure.purpose: Tile values and spend totals; 28px on phones, 26px calendar month total. Always weight 400.

panel-title.purpose: Panel heads and the quick-note head.

body.purpose: Default text, buttons, inputs, nav. Notes at 15px/1.55.

label.purpose: Tile labels, group heads (600), field labels, sub lines (400), panel meta and links.

caption.purpose: Time pills, legends, hints, note footers.

axis.purpose: Day-line hours, bar axis, calendar overflow (11.5-12px).

shadows.name: event-edge

shadows.name: selected-ring

shadows.name: segment-ring

shadows.name: today-bar

shadows.name: sidebar-focus

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border hovers; always inside @media (hover: hover).

narrative.northStar: A Calm Home for One Day
narrative.overview:
Syncrona is a personal planner that reads like a quiet room rather than an office. A light cream page holds cream panels a step deeper, beside a solid navy sidebar; inside the panels sit near-white cream row cards, each one a real thing you can tick, add or read. The page opens with a serif greeting and one sentence of fact about the day ("1 task overdue, and Finish portfolio case study draft at 17:00"), then four count tiles, then the Today panel with the day line, its signature. Every other screen (tasks, calendar, expenses, notes, settings) is built from the same panels and rows, so the product feels like one place.

Depth is tonal, not cast. Three grounds (page, panel, card) do all the layering, and nothing at rest carries a shadow. Colour is held to three materials: navy for all text and for the sidebar, warm cream for the page, panels and cards, and one deep wine that marks every action, every selection and the day's own data. Burnt orange appears only when something is late or over the limit, or when something has gone wrong, pitched well away from the wine so "late" never reads as "act". After dark the world turns over: navy grounds, cream text and a lifted rose wine. Density is comfortable desktop-app density (14px body, 56px rows, 16px gutters) in the Linear, Things and Raycast register, with Instrument Sans throughout and Instrument Serif for a single line of greeting.

The world refuses the spreadsheet. Lists are stacks of separate row cards with 6px between them, never ruled tables; the calendar is a grid of separate cards, never a ruled month; numbers are tabular figures inside rows, never columns of cells.
keyCharacteristics: Light cream page, cream panels, near-white cream row cards: three grounds, no shadows at rest, framed by a solid navy sidebar.
Navy is the ink: every line of text, and the sidebar's ground.
Deep wine is the only hue that acts or marks today's data; burnt orange only for late, over-limit and error.
Instrument Sans for everything; Instrument Serif for the greeting and auth titles alone.
Three radii: 22px panels, 12px row cards, full pills on controls.
Centred 1100px column on a 12-column, 16px-gap grid beside a 240px labelled sidebar.
The day line: 06:00 to midnight, wine event pills, task rings, a live now marker and the day's spend at its end.
Motion is press-scale and a quick settle; nothing performs an entrance.

rules.name: The One Wine Rule
rules.body: Wine is the only accent. Navy and cream are this world's ink and paper, not accents. If it is wine, it can be pressed, it is selected, or it is today's data. Never use it as decoration, never introduce a second accent.

rules.name: The Orange Means Late Rule
rules.body: In data, burnt orange (the `red` token) marks exactly two things: a task past its due day, and a payment at or over the user's threshold. Nothing else in the data is burnt orange; in chrome, it is reserved for errors and destructive actions. It never stands in for the wine, and the wine never signals lateness.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Depth is the step from light cream page to cream panel to near-white cream card (navy page, navy panel, lifted navy card in dark mode). A new surface takes one of those three grounds; it does not invent a fourth tint. The navy sidebar is the one frame outside them, and only navigation lives on it.

rules.name: The One Line of Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif sets the greeting on Today and the titles on login and sign-up, nothing else. No serif panel titles, no serif numbers.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every time, amount, count and date is set with tabular numerals so columns of rows align without becoming a table.

rules.name: The Centred Column Rule
rules.body: Content never runs edge to edge on desktop; it sits in the 1100px column, and every panel snaps to the 12-column grid.

rules.name: The Only Floating Things Lift Rule
rules.body: If it scrolls with the page, it has no shadow. A shadow means the thing is above the page and can be dismissed.

rules.name: The Three Radii Rule
rules.body: Panel 22, card 12, control pill. A new component picks one by what it is, not by how big it is.

rules.name: The Press and Settle Rule
rules.body: Motion answers the user's own action: a press scales, a check fills, a new row settles. Nothing performs an entrance on page load.

dos: **Do** build every new screen from the same three grounds: light cream page, cream panel (22px), near-white cream row cards (12px) inside it, with navy text throughout.
**Do** use wine for the one primary action per area, for selection, and for today's data; keep everything else neutral.
**Do** use burnt orange (the `red` token) only for overdue tasks, payments at or over the threshold, errors and destructive actions.
**Do** show lists as row cards with a lead, a title, a sub line and an end slot, 6px apart, with actions revealed on hover.
**Do** set times, amounts, counts and dates in tabular figures, with amounts in rupees (₹).
**Do** keep controls as full pills (buttons 38px, segments 30px, time pills 24px).
**Do** gate hover styles behind `(hover: hover)`, give presses a 0.97 scale on the ease-out curve, and respect reduced motion.
**Do** design empty, loading (skeleton rows) and error (callout with Try again) states for every list.
donts: **Don't** put a shadow on anything that scrolls with the page; only the Quick note button, its popover, toasts and the mobile sheet lift.

**Don't** lay data out as a ruled table or spreadsheet grid; separate cards replace ruled rows and cells. Hairlines are kept for the mobile top bar's edge, the user-row and settings separators, and the day line's three-hour ticks.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or use wine as decoration.
**Don't** use wine for lateness or burnt orange for actions; the two must never trade places.
**Don't** put content panels or data on the navy sidebar, or use navy as a content ground in light mode; navy is the ink and the sidebar's frame.
**Don't** use Instrument Serif outside the greeting and the auth titles.
**Don't** set large figures bold; tile figures and totals stay at weight 400.
**Don't** put payments on the day line's track; they have no time and live in the legend total and the rows.
